title: Model更新でToken消費プロファイル（出力冗長度・Cache計上）が急変し、固定Plan Quotaが数分〜数時間で枯渇して長時間作業が成立しなくなる
summary: UPDATE candidate targeting K07 (material change). In the same week two vendors' model rollouts drastically changed consumption profiles against unchanged plan quotas. Claude Fable 5.1 (shipped 2026-09-01): #91623 measures 2x output tokens per turn vs Fable 5 and a Max 20x plan drained in ~22h; #91289 hits 100% of limit in 20 min; #91471 exhausts a 5-hour window in 30 min; press (techbytes.app) reports a 20x Max 5-hour quota gone in 52 minutes from one prompt, partly via heavy cache accounting, and Anthropic resetting meters at launch. OpenAI GPT-6 Astra: codex#43230 (burn 'drastically increased'), #43222 (weekly quota depletion disproportionate to local token telemetry), #43141 (limit re-hit in under an hour after reset). Mechanism refines K07+K02+K06: quota interruption is no longer steady-state but step-changes at model updates with no re-calibration, invalidating workflows sized to the previous profile overnight.
proposed_category: K: 運用・計測（Model更新起因のQuota枯渇）
